message: v10.7.13 fixes the Datacenters tab legacy Serving Capacity flash. The older compatibility renderer can still update internally, but its obsolete panel is hidden before first paint so switching away from and back to Datacenters shows only the Shared Physical Compute UI. All v10.7.12 shared-compute, cloud gaming, cloud rendering, AI gaming silicon, difficulty, adoption, interaction, licensing and human-voice tutorial systems remain included.
